# Nova API — /api/access-requests

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/access-requests`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## GET /api/access-requests

Operation id `access_requests_list`: in Python `client.call("access_requests_list", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api access_requests_list`.

`GET /api/access-requests` — the caller's own requests, newest first, at most 50.

The caller's own access requests: which catalog and group they asked for, the requested verbs and why, and whether the request is still open. Newest first, at most 50. Another person's requests are never listed.

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The caller's requests, newest first |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## POST /api/access-requests

Operation id `access_requests_create`: in Python `client.call("access_requests_create", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api access_requests_create`.

`POST /api/access-requests` — `201` with the stored row.

Ask the owner group of a catalog for access: the group (the caller must be a member of it), the catalog, one or more of `browse`, `select`, `write`, `create`, and a reason of at most 500 characters. `manage` belongs to the catalog's owner and cannot be requested. The requester is the signed-in caller, never part of the body. An owner group's IdP that leaves the groups out of the token cannot be judged here, so such a request is accepted and the approval decides. The request changes no grant.

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `catalog` | string | Yes |  | The catalog the access is asked for. |  |
| `group` | string | Yes |  | The group whose approval is asked for; the caller must be a member. |  |
| `reason` | string | Yes |  | Why, in one sentence, at most 500 characters. |  |
| `verbs` | array of string | Yes |  | What to ask for: one or more of `browse`, `select`, `write`, `create`. |  |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `201` | The stored row |
| `400` | The group, catalog or reason is empty, the reason is over 500 characters, or a verb is unknown, repeated or `manage` |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | The caller is not a member of the requested group |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## GET /api/access-requests/\{id\}

Operation id `access_requests_read`: in Python `client.call("access_requests_read", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api access_requests_read`.

`GET /api/access-requests/{id}` — the caller's own row; somebody else's is a 404.

One of the caller's own access requests. Another person's request answers 404, exactly like an id that does not exist: the API never confirms that it is there.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The access request's id |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The row |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `404` | No such request for this caller |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## DELETE /api/access-requests/\{id\}

Operation id `access_requests_withdraw`: in Python `client.call("access_requests_withdraw", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api access_requests_withdraw`.

`DELETE /api/access-requests/{id}` — withdraw one's own open request; `200` with the row.

Withdraw one of the caller's own open access requests: its state becomes `withdrawn` and it keeps that state. A request that is already withdrawn answers 409, another person's 404. Nothing is deleted, and no grant is touched.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The access request's id |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The row, now `withdrawn` |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `404` | No such request for this caller |
| `409` | The request was already withdrawn |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |
